attchmntText: Sir/Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 47 Of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, please find enclosed herewith copies of the newspaper publications of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 published in the English and Telugu newspapers on 14/11/2026 as appended below;1. Business Standard (English daily)2.Telugu Prabha (Telugu daily)
voiceSummary: XTGlobal Infotech Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The publications appeared in Business Standard and Telugu Prabha on 14 November 2026. The Board of Directors of Sonal Adhesives Limited approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 at a meeting held on 13 November 2026. The Board of Directors of TARC Limited approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 at a meeting held on 12 November 2025. Celebrity Fashions Limited approved Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 at a Board Meeting held on 13 November 2026. Prime Focus Limited approved Un-audited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 at a meeting held on 13 November 2026. Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 at a meeting held on 13 November 2026.

attchmntText: Xtglobal Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 46500  Shares.
voiceSummary: XTGlobal Infotech Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the allotment of 46,500 equity shares of Rs. 1 each to eligible employees on November 13, 2026. This allotment was made pursuant to the exercise of options and restricted stock units under the XTGlobal Infotech Limited Employees Stock Benefit Scheme 2020. The exercise price per share was Rs. 20. Consequently, the company's paid-up equity share capital increased from Rs. 13,41,23,705 to Rs. 13,41,70,205. The total number of issued shares rose from 13,41,23,705 to 13,41,70,205. The newly allotted shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. No lock-in period applies to these shares. The intimation was filed with the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Xtglobal Infotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: XTGlobal Infotech Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board met on 13 November 2026 via video conferencing. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, income from operations was 3,829.83 lakhs. Net profit after tax stood at 408.47 lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share were 0.30. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, income from operations was 1,911.08 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 226.27 lakhs. Basic and diluted earnings per share were 0.17. The company operates in a single segment, IT/ITES. There were no deviations in the use of proceeds from public issues. No defaults on loans or debt securities were reported. The statutory auditors issued unmodified Limited Review Reports.
